info.description: Description of the component, which is created by the Block. Text can contain links . If info as object is set, it can contains: help [node] - custom info about the content of the component, fls [object] @since 1.27.0 baseUri [string] - baseUri to uuFls, where will be send requests according to the content of the component, tagList [string[]] - list of tags which must be supported in used uuFls awid, topic [string] - topic which must be supported in used uuFls awid. sls [object] @since 1.27.0 baseUri [string] - baseUri to uuSls, where will be send requests according to the content of the component, tagList [string[]] - list of tags which must be supported in used uuSls awid, topic [string] - topic which must be supported in used uuSls awid. uu5Tag [string] - @since 1.26.0 uu5Tag of the component, which the info belongs to, actionList [object[]] - @since 1.26.0 array of button's props. It is possible to set custom button component by { component: MyComponent } displayAwidAbout [bool-object] - @since 1.37.0 if set, AwidAbout button is displayed in Help tab in Help center if help is also set. If it is necessary to change default label for the button, it could be done as object with key label as node. E.g. displayAwidAbout={true} or displayAwidAbout={{ label: "About AWID" }} or displayAwidAbout={{ label: <Lsi ... /> }} displayAsidAbout [bool-object] - @since 1.37.0 if set, AsidAbout button is displayed in Advanced tab in Help center. If it is necessary to change default label for the button, it could be done as object with key label as node. E.g. displayAsidAbout={true} or displayAsidAbout={{ label: "About ASID" }} or displayAsidAbout={{ label: <Lsi ... /> }} flsBaseUri [string] - @since 1.21.0 @deprecated 1.27.0 baseUri to uuFls, where will be send requests according to the content of the component, slsBaseUri [string] - @since 1.21.0 @deprecated 1.27.0 baseUri to uuSls, where will be send requests according to the content of the component, Example: info={{ help: <Lsi lsi={{ cs: "...", en: "..." }} />, fls: { baseUri: "https://uuapp.plus4u.net/..." }, sls: { baseUri: "https://uuapp.plus4u.net/..." }, uu5Tag: "UuFinmanBricks.BalanceSummary", actionList: [ { children: <Lsi lsi={{ en: "Permission settings", cs: "Nastavení práv" }}, onClick: () => ... }, { component: StateHistoryButton }, { component: <RelationsButton oid="abc123" /> }, ] }}

baseUri.description: Technical base uri with subApp name and awid of the uuSubApp whose data should be provided by this component. If no value is provided, the current application workspace’s base URI is used.

initialValue.description: Specifies the default visual settings. Intended for use with a custom tab defined in tabList . Values provided here can override loaded visual settings, so only include keys relevant to your custom tab.

onSave.description: Function could be synchronous or asynchronous and it is run after all validations completed without error after submitting form. Parameters: event [object] - object with value and file. event.data.value - the value is an object containing values from all nested input components, using "input name -> input value" mapping. event.data.files - the files is an object containing generated images Allows you to inject custom logic before the internal save method is called. You can also call e.preventDefault() to skip the internal logic entirely and handle the save process with your own implementation.

tabList.description: Defines additional visual settings tabs. Mandatory tabs which are always displayed: basic - for visual identification settings, from which other tabs take a defaults, icon - for overriding settings for favicon and icon, social - for overriding settings for OG image, logo - for overriding settings for several types of logos. The array's items could be one of template names (string value): top - for overriding settings for top bar in uuApp, where is also Plus4U button, For this tab you need to provide data in initialValue (see structure on VisualSettings.View ) and also store data by yourself. hero - for overriding settings for hero logo, which is for full width. Item in the array could be also custom tab as object with the following structure: label [node] - the label shown in the tab, code [string] - the tab code (for identifying that this tab is active), children [node - func] - If a function is used, it receives an object containing paddings. In this case modal does not have a padding and it must be somehow used in rendered content as in example. style [object] - style object containing paddingLeft , paddingTop , paddingRight , paddingBottom values to achieve standard look. Example: {({ style }) => <div className={Css.css(style)}>...</div>} Example: tabList={["top", "hero"]} or tabList={[{ label: <Lsi lsi={{ en: "Background" }} />, children: <BackgroundTab /> }]}
